Both p values are displayed as 0.0000 (the register holds 0E-10; the pooled z of 26.72 gives about 3e-157). That reads as a p of exactly zero, and '< 0.0001' would be accurate.
The completion caveat 'one quarter of orders in this channel' is the only statement of the rate's denominator, and it does not say that cancelled and pending orders are included.
